caseName: Vermont Yankee Nuclear Power Corp. v. Natural Resources Defense Council, Inc.
caseNameFull: Vermont Yankee Nuclear Power Corp. v. Natural Resources Defense Council, Inc. and Consumers Power Co. v. Aeschliman

opinions.text:
C. A. D. C. Cir. [Certiorari granted, 429 U. S. 1090.] Motion of Pacific Legal Foundation for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of Hans A. Bethe et al., for leave to file a brief as amici curiae in No. 76-528 granted.

Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions.
